title: Vendor Intake Training Sign-Off Form
subtitle: A practical observed-practice training sign-off for vendor intake that connects identity, observations and evidence, decision authority, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original retail-operations observed-practice training sign-off for vendor intake covering vendor onboarding and access, evidence references, authorization, escalation, operating limits, disposition, and handoff without copying a third-party form.
use_case: Use when a vendor coordinator opens one vendor intake record to plan instruction, observe practice, identify knowledge and authority limits, assign follow-up, and acknowledge the resulting work scope; closure requires a documented outcome, evidence route, responsible owner, and recipient acknowledgment.

sections.title: Vendor training sign-off identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this training sign-off to one location, operating period, accountable owner, and review route.

blocks.label: Vendor event scope, trigger, affected area, and prior handoff

fields.label: Vendor Intake scope and routing context

sections.title: Vendor training plan and learner route
sections.guidance: Define the procedure revision, learning method, practice setting, supervisor, and authorized scope.

blocks.label: Vendor competencies
items: Defines vendor identity, sponsor, and exact scope
Routes purchasing and payment setup correctly
Tracks required records without claiming validation
Classifies site, system, data, and badge access
Collects only necessary vendor information
Recognizes conflict and subcontractor review needs
Documents conditions and expiration dates
Prevents work before required approval
Communicates approval, hold, or rejection
Assigns renewal and offboarding ownership

blocks.label: Training and authorization boundary
blocks.guidance: Use references and status fields rather than copying tax identifiers, bank details, identity documents, credentials, or confidential contracts into this general form. A listed document is not a legal or professional validation. Follow applicable purchasing, access, privacy, security, and retention policy and route specialist judgments to the authorized reviewer. This sign-off records observed practice and assigned limits; it is not a license, professional certification, or guarantee of future performance.

sections.title: Vendor coached practice and evidence
sections.guidance: Record the scenario, learner action, observable result, coaching, and next attempt rather than a generic pass mark.

blocks.label: Exception scenarios reviewed
items: Vendor identity or ownership review unresolved
Required record or policy acknowledgment missing
Sensitive access requires specialist approval
Emergency or temporary vendor route requested
Commercial terms or payment setup disputed
Start, renewal, suspension, or rejection decision pending

blocks.label: Strengths, repeated errors, prompts required, evidence references, and conditions for another observation

sections.title: Vendor knowledge check, limits, and escalation
sections.guidance: Confirm that the learner can identify sources, stop conditions, authorization limits, escalation owners, and handoff evidence.

blocks.label: Condition and exception knowledge
items: Vendor identity or authorized contact mismatch
Scope, site, product, or subcontractor unclear
Required document expired, missing, or not applicable
Data, system, key, badge, or after-hours access requested
Commercial setup differs from approved purchase route
Conflict or restricted-category review needed
Operational owner has not accepted the handoff
Start date precedes completed approvals

blocks.label: Knowledge gaps, restricted tasks, retraining topics, interim supervision, and evidence needed

fields.label: Vendor Intake knowledge gaps and limits

sections.title: Vendor work authorization and follow-up plan
sections.guidance: Grant only the observed scope and state the supervision, expiry, reassessment, or restriction that applies.

blocks.label: Training authorization handoff
items: Readiness decision communicated to scheduler
Restricted tasks visible to supervising owner
Procedure version and practice evidence linked
Coach accepted follow-up responsibility
Reassessment date or trigger recorded
Learner can identify the escalation route

sections.title: Vendor outcome, closeout, and handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and acceptance visible.

blocks.label: Vendor closeout controls
items: Approved vendor ID and scope recorded
Site, system, and data access owners notified
Commercial setup reference linked in restricted system
Conditions and expiration dates have owners
Start or hold decision communicated to sponsor
Renewal and offboarding responsibility assigned

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Unresolved work, customer or staff impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Vendor Intake residual work and handoff

blocks.label: Training Sign-Off closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not a legal, safety, or professional certification.
